cohort: Women who delivered or experienced maternal death between 2004 and 2014 in the United States
finding: Women with an ADHD diagnosis had a higher incidence of several maternal and neonatal complications compared to women without ADHD, including cesarean delivery, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and small-for-gestational-age neonates.
mod_finding: Women with ADHD had a higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to those without ADHD.
